comparison.objective: Use a tong puller to rock the named fuse out of spring clips and deposit it in a tray; the candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1628 tests tool pickup, jaw placement on a fuse, sequential levering of two clip ends, and controlled removal; the candidate tests coaxial driver/wrench use and counterholding during nut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1628 requires F2 removal with the puller and tray placement while F1/F3 remain seated; the candidate requires precise angle retention over repeated cycles with retained hardware.
comparison.reason: Tool-mediated extraction from spring clips is a different physical ability from preserving a threaded adjustment against locknut torque.
